operator.notes: Havoc teamserver (docker compose per localhavoc reference). The teamserver itself is NEVER internet-exposed.

redirector.notes: cloudflared tunnel fronts the teamserver behind a clean domain with managed TLS — callbacks see CDN IPs, not the TS IP (same egress-mask philosophy as egress-proxy --socks5).

hardening: run the teamserver as a dedicated non-root user/container, no shell history on the box
host firewall: allow ONLY the cloudflared outbound connection + your SSH source IP
rotate listener profile/domain at teardown; record artifacts in sessions.js teardown ledger

notes: Copia in c2.json (gitignorato) e compila. Profili di listener per generare implant: host = dove il target richiama. Usa lan_https per engagement interni, vps_mtls (col tuo VPS/redirector) per target su internet, havoc_cdn quando serve C2 dietro CDN con dominio pulito (profilo Havoc, repo-vet churchofmalware QW8).
